PROVENANCE AND VERIFICATION -- READ BEFORE TRUSTING THIS FILE.
The keys below are drafted against published Mozilla Firefox STIG requirements. They are
NOT machine-generated from the benchmark. Before this is used as a compliance artifact:
1. Download the current STIG from https://public.cyber.mil/stigs/downloads/
2. Reconcile every rule in the XCCDF against this file -- both directions.
3. Populate _stig_rules below with the V-IDs actually present in that release.
Rule IDs are deliberately left empty rather than guessed: a wrong V-ID in a compliance
artifact is worse than an absent one.
Firefox also accepts policy from HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Mozilla\Firefox. The file
is used here because it is the portable, documented mechanism and is reviewable in git.
Settings the policy engine does not expose need the autoconfig pair -- see README.md.

_stig_rules._comment: Populate from the XCCDF: { "V-xxxxxx": "policy key that satisfies it" }.
_stig_rules._benchmark_version: UNVERIFIED - set to the release this file was reconciled against

*.blocked_install_message: Extension installation is restricted by policy.

_comment_review_before_enabling: The keys below appear in some STIG releases and are mission-affecting. Decide each one
against the benchmark and the desktop's purpose rather than inheriting this default.
SanitizeOnShutdown  - clears history at exit; conflicts with rules requiring
browser history be RETAINED. Confirm which way the release runs.
Cookies             - third-party cookie behaviour and Locked state.
Homepage / newtab   - site-specific, not a generic hardening value.
WebsiteFilter       - the URL blocklist equivalent; populate per environment.
